summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 1,000,000 of its own ordinary shares on 29 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 112.4923 pence per share. These repurchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026, with instructions to Goldman Sachs International as broker. The company intends to cancel all purchased shares. This open-market buyback reduces share count, returning capital to shareholders. A full trade breakdown is provided via a linked RNS document. The programme continues; watch for future announcements on completion or extension.
